content.short: Fast Society is a cross-chain racing project on Cardano and Solana featuring hand-drawn NFT muscle cars and real prizes.
content.description: Fast Society is an innovative cross-chain project bridging the Cardano and Solana ecosystems through high-quality NFT art and utility. The collection features 8,888 hand-drawn classic muscle cars, split equally between both blockchains. Beyond the digital assets, the project offers a high-stakes raffle where holders can win a real 1969 Red Mach1 Ford Mustang. In partnership with Mousetrap Games, Fast Society is also developing a mobile-first, Play-and-Earn racing game that allows NFT holders to earn a share of the platform revenue, creating a unique link between gaming and physical rewards.
